content: nixfmt-rfc-style implements RFC 166 standard Nix format; expected community default, enforced in nixpkgs (consensus: most polished pretty-printer; alejandra unconfigurable/opinionated, diverges from RFC style). 25.11 release notes: classic nixfmt retained as pkgs.nixfmt-classic, plain nixfmt attr now RFC-style. Wire as formatter.<system> = pkgs.nixfmt-rfc-style (nix fmt) and a checks entry running nixfmt --check on *.nix files for nix flake check integration.
